backend/main.mo: Motoko backend managing user profiles, roles, access control, and system reset logic with admin allowlisting and signup/update flows.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs with confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries for numerous frontend files including pages, components, hooks, and utilities.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment runbook explaining normal vs fresh publish procedures, verification steps, and troubleshooting guidance.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes with consistent UI tokens.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entrypoint loading the root div and main TypeScript bundle.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component defining routing, authentication flow, profile setup gating, session invalid handling, and admin route protection.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: UI component showing an admin-only access restriction message with a button returning to the home page.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Renders the main header with navigation, showing report, history, admin, and logout options based on authentication and admin status.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Wraps the app with header, main content area, and footer branding.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Displays login/signup options using Internet Identity with handling for stale sessions.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Provides a signup form with validation for user profile details and role selection, submitting via a signup mutation.
frontend/src/components/SessionInvalidSc: Shows a session-expired message with an option to fully log out and retry authentication.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to the current identity, refreshing dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFullLogout.ts: Implements full logout by clearing Internet Identity, session storage, React Query cache, and reloading the app.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login, logout, and persisted identity loading.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for user profile, admin actions, and report operations using an ICP backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS layers and theme variables for light and dark modes with industrial color accents.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminUsersPage.tsx: Admin interface for listing, deleting, purging, and resetting user data with confirmation dialogs and access control.
frontend/src/pages/ReportDetailPage.tsx: Displays full details of a service report with status, customer info, machine info, and navigation back to history.
frontend/src/pages/ReportEntryPage.tsx: Form for creating service reports with validation, submission handling, and success feedback.
frontend/src/pages/ReportHistoryPage.tsx: Shows a searchable, filterable history of service reports sorted by date.
frontend/src/utils/authErrorDetection.ts: Detects common authentication-related error messages to identify invalid or expired user sessions.
frontend/src/utils/authSessionCleanup.ts: Clears auth-related items from localStorage and sessionStorage for logout cleanup.
Maps backend signup errors to simple user-facing messages.
frontend/src/utils/signupValidation.ts: Provides basic required-field, email, and mobile number validation helpers.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Handles extracting, storing, and clearing URL parameters using query strings, hash routing, and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS with custom colors, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, feature lists, and pending feature requests for the signup cleanup project.
